events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Alex DeBrincat and Lucas Raymond each scored a goal and added an assist and Cam Talbot made 18 saves in relief of John Gibson to lead the Detroit Red Wings to a 4-2 victory over the Nashville Predators on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeBrincat, Raymond each have goal, assist and Red Wings top Preds 4-2

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Kirill Marchenko scored his second goal of the game 1:04 into overtime and the Columbus Blue Jackets edged the New York Rangers 5-4 Monday night after squandering a four-goal lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marchenko scores 2nd goal in OT as Blue Jackets weather a furious comeback try and beat Rangers 5-4

events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Matvei Michkov and Trevor Zegras scored in a shootout and the Philadelphia Flyers extended their winning streak to three games with a 3-2 win over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flyers beat Maple Leafs 3-2 in a shootout to extend winning streak to 3 games

headlines.description: — Lian Bichsel scored twice and the Dallas Stars beat the Vancouver Canucks 6-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stars beat Canucks 6-1 to extend winning streak to a franchise-record 9 games

headlines.description: — Ben Meyers scored his career-high sixth goal and the Seattle Kraken ended Carolina's point streak at 12 games by beating the Hurricanes 2-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daccord backstops Kraken to 2-1 win, ending 12-game point streak for Hurricanes

events.name: Colorado Avalanche at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Devon Toews scored the tiebreaking goal late in the third period, Martin Necas added an empty-netter to go with two assists, and the Colorado Avalanche defeated the Los Angeles Kings 4-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Toews scores late winner as Avalanche beat Kings 4-2 in Los Angeles' first game under new coach
